QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_20

question.text: SEBI defines a 'Hedge Fund' as an AIF which:

answer.text: Employs diverse or complex trading strategies and invests/trades in securities with diverse risks or complex products

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 1.2.3, SEBI definition focuses on diverse/complex trading strategies and diverse-risk/complex products. The Trap: Narrow definitions don't match SEBI. Cross-Exam Context: Canonical SEBI definition. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Quote SEBI definition verbatim in PPMs and client communications.
